_comment: Non-secret defaults. Values you change in the dashboard are stored in SQLite and override these. Secrets live in ~/.agentstation/secrets.env and ~/.openclaw/.env, never here.

limits._comment: Token caps are enforced from usage OpenClaw reports. 2,000,000 tokens/day is roughly $5/day at Claude Sonnet 5.5 API rates for this workload (measured: ~145k reported tokens and ~$0.35 API-equivalent per team task, 2026-10-09). The Claude subscription is not billed per token; this is a reference conversion only.

actions._comment: External actions need human approval AND a destination listed here. Empty list = no external action can run.
